evidence: T-0039 covers Goal #30 P1.2.1-P1.2.5 only.
Structured workflow validation is implemented through scripts/shiki_workflows.py and scripts/validate_shiki.py.
Required checks from .shiki/config.yaml are compared with actual workflow job display names, not comments, job ids, or unrelated strings.
Bounded JSON Schema validation is implemented through scripts/shiki_jsonschema.py; unsupported features such as $ref, oneOf, anyOf, allOf, format, dependencies, and if/then/else fail explicitly.
actionlint and shellcheck are integrated through scripts/test_shiki_workflow_lint.sh, scripts/test_shiki_shellcheck.sh, and the Shiki Validate workflow.
Node.js 20 warning handling upgrades official actions to Node 24-compatible major versions, sets FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24=true, and forbids ACTIONS_ALLOW_USE_UNSECURE_NODE_VERSION.
False-positive and false-negative coverage is added in scripts/test_shiki_validator_hardening.sh.
Required skill evidence: diagnose was used to classify CI/validator failure modes and separate validator defects from workflow lint defects.
Required skill evidence: tdd was used by adding failing false-positive and false-negative validator fixtures before relying on implementation behavior.
Required skill evidence: improve-codebase-architecture was used to centralize workflow parsing and bounded JSON Schema validation in shared helper modules rather than scattering raw string checks.
